title: Houston temp anomaly -> NG volatility
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Houston temperature anomaly 20d z-score > 1.5 leads Henry Hub absolute returns (volatility, not direction) by 3 days (+); trade long NG=F straddle proxy 3d [weather.houston.temp_anomaly -> finance.NG=F.abs_return] (parent: R2-0035)
message: Not supported: Houston temp anomaly vs NG abs_return r=-0.37 (n=388), sign opposite to hypothesis; best lag -4d r=-0.40. Trade rule mechanically positive (abs_return target) but not a volatility-lead signal.

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.houston.temp_anomaly rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long NG=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Houston temperature anomaly 20d z-score > 1 leads LOWER Henry Hub intraday range by 4 days (-): warm anomalies calm NG volatility; trade short NG=F range proxy 4d [weather.houston.temp_anomaly -> finance.NG=F.range_pct] (parent: R2-0130)
